The game is currently in pre-alpha. There may be bugs.

Mojave Valley is an experimental realistic California roleplay game! Built off the real-life Mojave, CA location with many fictional elements intertwined. Earn money by driving realistic cars or just roleplay with your friends! There's plenty to discover.  

Inquiries/In-game rules/Data loss? All of it can be found inside the communications server!

Controls (Console):

DPad (Left/Right): Turn Signals
DPad (Down): F (Press LT + DPad Down to start car)
ButtonX: Shift Down
ButtonY: Shift Up
ButtonB: Hazards

This game offers benefits for Roblox Plus/Premium Players!

10% Drive-to-Earn payouts
+10% increased job earnings
+5% bonus cash on all cash purchases
+5% additional rewards from redeemed codes
Weekly $4,999 in-game cash bonus
Exclusive [Roblox Plus+] chat tag and player badge
